objects.name: owner_setup_context_binding_immutable
objects.sql:
CREATE TRIGGER owner_setup_context_binding_immutable BEFORE UPDATE ON owner_setup_contexts
 WHEN OLD.right_id IS NOT NULL AND (NEW.context_hash IS NOT OLD.context_hash OR NEW.owner_id IS NOT OLD.owner_id OR NEW.operation_id IS NOT OLD.operation_id OR NEW.right_id IS NOT OLD.right_id OR NEW.issuer IS NOT OLD.issuer OR NEW.audience IS NOT OLD.audience OR NEW.subject IS NOT OLD.subject OR NEW.expires_at IS NOT OLD.expires_at OR NEW.created_at IS NOT OLD.created_at)
 BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT,'owner setup binding is immutable'); END

objects.name: owner_setup_context_no_extend
objects.sql:
CREATE TRIGGER owner_setup_context_no_extend BEFORE UPDATE ON owner_setup_contexts
 WHEN NEW.expires_at>OLD.expires_at OR NEW.created_at IS NOT OLD.created_at
 BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT,'owner setup context lifetime is fixed'); END

objects.name: owner_setup_contexts
objects.sql:
CREATE TABLE owner_setup_contexts (
 context_hash TEXT PRIMARY KEY CHECK(length(context_hash)=64),
 csrf_hash TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(length(csrf_hash)=64),
 created_at INTEGER NOT NULL,
 expires_at INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(expires_at>created_at),
 revoked_at INTEGER,
 owner_id TEXT REFERENCES principals(id),
 operation_id TEXT,
 right_id TEXT UNIQUE REFERENCES password_setup_rights(id),
 issuer TEXT,
 audience TEXT,
 subject TEXT,
 CHECK((owner_id IS NULL AND operation_id IS NULL AND right_id IS NULL AND issuer IS NULL AND audience IS NULL AND subject IS NULL)
  OR (owner_id IS NOT NULL AND operation_id IS NOT NULL AND right_id IS NOT NULL AND issuer IS NOT NULL AND audience IS NOT NULL AND subject IS NOT NULL))
)

objects.name: owner_setup_operation
objects.sql: CREATE UNIQUE INDEX owner_setup_operation ON owner_setup_contexts(owner_id,operation_id) WHERE owner_id IS NOT NULL

objects.name: recipient_setup_binding_immutable
objects.sql:
CREATE TRIGGER recipient_setup_binding_immutable BEFORE UPDATE ON recipient_setup_contexts
 WHEN NEW.context_hash IS NOT OLD.context_hash OR NEW.request_id IS NOT OLD.request_id OR NEW.replaces_context_hash IS NOT OLD.replaces_context_hash
 OR (OLD.right_id IS NOT NULL AND (NEW.issuer_id IS NOT OLD.issuer_id OR NEW.issuer_display_name IS NOT OLD.issuer_display_name OR NEW.operation_id IS NOT OLD.operation_id OR NEW.principal_id IS NOT OLD.principal_id OR NEW.right_id IS NOT OLD.right_id OR NEW.purpose IS NOT OLD.purpose OR NEW.target_auth_version IS NOT OLD.target_auth_version OR NEW.expires_at IS NOT OLD.expires_at))
 BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT,'recipient setup binding is immutable'); END

objects.name: recipient_setup_contexts
objects.sql:
CREATE TABLE recipient_setup_contexts (
 context_hash TEXT PRIMARY KEY CHECK(length(context_hash)=64),
 request_id TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE CHECK(length(request_id)=43),
 replaces_context_hash TEXT UNIQUE CHECK(replaces_context_hash IS NULL OR length(replaces_context_hash)=64),
 csrf_hash TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(length(csrf_hash)=64),
 created_at INTEGER NOT NULL,
 expires_at INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(expires_at>created_at),
 revoked_at INTEGER,
 issuer_id TEXT REFERENCES principals(id),
 issuer_display_name TEXT,
 operation_id TEXT,
 principal_id TEXT REFERENCES principals(id),
 right_id TEXT UNIQUE REFERENCES password_setup_rights(id),
 purpose TEXT CHECK(purpose IN ('initial','reset')),
 target_auth_version INTEGER,
 CHECK((issuer_id IS NULL AND issuer_display_name IS NULL AND operation_id IS NULL AND principal_id IS NULL AND right_id IS NULL AND purpose IS NULL AND target_auth_version IS NULL)
  OR (issuer_id IS NOT NULL AND issuer_display_name IS NOT NULL AND operation_id IS NOT NULL AND principal_id IS NOT NULL AND right_id IS NOT NULL AND purpose IS NOT NULL AND target_auth_version IS NOT NULL))
)

objects.name: recipient_setup_no_extend
objects.sql:
CREATE TRIGGER recipient_setup_no_extend BEFORE UPDATE ON recipient_setup_contexts
 WHEN NEW.expires_at>OLD.expires_at OR NEW.created_at IS NOT OLD.created_at OR (OLD.revoked_at IS NOT NULL AND NEW.revoked_at IS NOT OLD.revoked_at)
 BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT,'recipient setup context lifetime is fixed'); END

objects.name: recipient_setup_operation
objects.sql: CREATE UNIQUE INDEX recipient_setup_operation ON recipient_setup_contexts(issuer_id,operation_id) WHERE issuer_id IS NOT NULL
